purpose: Approved8-model comparison and3 RCR ablations over3 datasets:30 fits/training cells +3 evaluation-only cells
precedence: This draft resolves only current effective values; historical plans remain immutable. After approval a new executable plan must bind source/data/environment and implement these rules; no fallback to historical defaults.

data.task: offline snippet/entity anomaly detection, not point labels or online prediction claims
data.split: normal entities70/10/20; all faults test only; same frozen IDs across models/seeds
data.cleaning: NaN/Inf/float32 overflow -> missing; within-snippet linear interpolation, nearest valid endpoint; entirely missing channel -> normal-training valid-value median; record counts; no smoothing or clipping finite fault amplitudes
data.missing_audit: retained original inputs audited: zero invalid values in all three datasets; new cleaning fallbacks inactive in this version
data.normalization: common train-only per-variable MinMax; each retained real training point counted once; denominator1 when range<1e-12; no clipping on validation/test
data.prepare_once: cleaned unnormalized float32 values, boundaries, IDs, labels, splits, scaler and version hashes; no raw parsing in model jobs
data.input_precision: prepared float32 then model dtype (TranAD double); no claim preserving original float64 precision
data.all_data_meaning: all retained normal snippets with declared stride, not every possible stride1 window; Omni drops final incomplete training batch only

rcr.graph: global learned node-embedding adjacency; not input-conditioned GAT

mtad.identity: ML4ITS third-party GATv2/GRU variant; not original paper exact implementation

tranad.identity: author released refactored implementation; not full paper MAML reproduction
tranad.layer_definition: author custom layers, no LayerNorm; preserve literal activation behavior
tranad.compatibility: legacy causal API arguments only; forward and gradient checks required

omni.identity: author-release semantics project PyTorch port; cross-framework parity not established
omni.noise: one independent truncated Gaussian group per50 windows; physical batch500 contains10 groups

svdd.identity: Deep SVDD (project MLP time-series adaptation), not author exact network
svdd.center: mean encoder output over ALL normaltrain windows after selected AE; fix permanently; abs(c)<.1 => -.1 if negative else+.1 including exactlyzero, matching existing project rule
svdd.selection: AE fixed epoch5 final, SVDD fixed epoch30 final; normal validation curves diagnostic, no early stopping or test-based selection
svdd.score: sum((encoder(x)-c)^2) per window; common top5% and normalvalidationP95
svdd.reference_difference: author MNIST example AE150+SVDD150, lr1e-4 and LeNet; present5+30/MLP/lr.001/wd0 are project existing budget/adapter choices, not paper recommendations; center zero handling and clip5 also declared project choices
svdd.basis: existing project structure and pretraining; published one-class fixed-center objective, audit against source before running

iforest.input: one real time point x7 channels for ALL datasets
iforest.training: one fit on entire retained normal-training point population; sklearn internal per-tree sampling retained; no external100k cap
iforest.score: -score_samples, not predict/decision threshold; existing common aggregation/P95
iforest.basis: 256 is sklearn auto per-tree sample default;200trees project existing choice, sklearn default100; pointwise input is project common adaptation and changes Brand1 old flattened variant
iforest.runtime: CPU; record sklearn version/effective CPUs/threads; GPU memory N/A; record fit and full scoring time

tranad.selection: final epoch5, not best test or first-stage validation loss
tranad.scheduler: StepLR(step_size=5,gamma=0.9), step after each completed epoch

at.selection: author dual validation comparator on NORMAL validation: save when neither objective is worse than its saved value, delta0; equal qualifies per author code
at.loss: backprop(rec-3*series_KL) and (rec+3*prior_KL); preserve both reconstruction gradients and detached branches

dc.selection: final epoch3; cancelling prior-series validation objective is diagnostic only

omni.selection: strict_minimum_full_normal_validation_release_loss, once per epoch, earliest on tie; run all10 epochs
omni.loss: mean(log q_flow - log p(x|z)); release stopped posterior gradients; no extra LGSSM prior or L2

svdd.selection: final epoch5 AE then final epoch30 one-class, no test or validation winner selection
svdd.loss: AE MSE, then mean squared distance to fixed normaltrain center

native_scores.rcr: window mean(((X-Xhat-mu(q))/sigma(q))**2) over time and all7 variables
native_scores.at: author softmax association weights at temperature50 * pointwise mean-variable reconstruction MSE
native_scores.dc: author softmax(-series_KL*50-prior_KL*50) across window positions; no reconstruction score
native_scores.omni: negative Gaussian reconstruction log_probability, sum_variables, last_input_point; one latent sample

validation: once per complete epoch; full normal validation; no test metrics during training; MTAD sample-weighted mean batch forecast RMSE+reconstruction RMSE, matching reference batch metric convention; others sample-weighted objectives; initial/half-epoch diagnostics excluded from checkpoint candidates
window_policy: span=window except MTAD span=window+1; starts from0 at declared stride, append final valid aligned window if absent; no padding; no cross-boundary targets; do not treat initial context as independent scored points

rcr_calibration.fit: all normal train windows at each model own stride, after selecting backbone checkpoint
rcr_calibration.mean: OLS window residual means on standardized q+intercept
rcr_calibration.scale: OLS log(max(centered_window_RMS,0.05)); exp(linear_prediction clipped[-30,30]); per-channel train-predictionP5/P95 clipped with lower floor0.05

evaluation.score_to_snippet: mean of top max(1,ceil(.05*n)) native scores
evaluation.AT_DC_overlap: average native scores at same real time point before snippet aggregation
evaluation.Brand1: top5% snippet scores per entity, same ceil rule; each entity one final observation
evaluation.threshold: per model/dataset/seed/variant normal validation final-object scores P95, numpy linear quantile; anomaly >= threshold
evaluation.report: single-seed numbers only; no seed std; no old-protocol metrics mixed as paired controls; Brand1 fixed single split not fivefold
evaluation.limitations: AP/AUROC and validation loss answer different questions; same data/evaluation does not mean same update budget; Brand1 P95 from16 normal validation entities unstable; repeated past test access disclosed

execution.device: one GPU per training job; actual assigned device/memory recorded before smoke
execution.precision: TranAD float64; all others float32; AMP/TF32/compile disabled
execution.resume: only same cell/config/code/data; save model, optimizer, scheduler, epoch/step, sampler and RNG states, early-stop state; no silent warm start
execution.checkpoint_policy: selected best (where applicable) plus latest recovery checkpoint; fixed-final models also save final; no every-epoch weight archive
execution.preflight: resolved plan values, reference implementation, model gradients/native scores, data bundle/scaler/IDs/boundaries, first batch, complete miniature evaluation path on Kaggle actual mounts; no multi-hour full preparation in GPU jobs
execution.immutability: clone submitted latest git once then record resolved commit; no mid-run git pull or pip change; changing code/data/protocol requires new task version
execution.notebook: orchestration in Kaggle notebook; no per-account launching scripts added to src
execution.local_download: runs/kaggle_downloads; original project filesystem retained, no C-drive relocation
execution.quota: record actual account session/wallclock/quota before allocating shards; do not assume all24 cells fit one session or an arbitrary4-way split
execution.failures: stop affected cell on nonfinite model states/OOM/mismatch; save explicit failure, no silent batch/window/data/score changes; completed cells preserved
execution.credential_selection: saved daisy OAuth; API-returned identity must equal daisychen2; do not use chen global access_token
execution.upload_requirement: Confirm this account own private dataset ready/version1 before kernel submission; content hashes remain unchanged

required_artifacts: selected and latest checkpoints with optimizer/RNG for resume
complete.json only after required checks pass

implementation_status.formal_runner: implemented; local smoke/tests and actual Kaggle mounted smoke are separate evidence
implementation_status.prepared_bundles: all3 datasets ready; bound manifest hashes
implementation_status.archive_and_efficiency: implemented; verify actual produced artifacts before reporting completion

resource_estimates.input_basis: approximately LFP.31 + NCM.096 + Brand1 1.59 GiB numeric inputs, excluding small metadata and packaging copies
resource_estimates.output_basis: engineering estimate for24cells with selected/latest states and native/object scores; exclude expanded windows/features/residual tensors; verify actual size before upload
resource_estimates.runtime: No reliable total Kaggle wallclock estimate until device and end-to-end scoring timings are measured. Local one-epoch tests are not Kaggle guarantees; no additional timing/training launched by this draft.

base_protocol_approval.meaning: C1 through C7 approved; formal entry enforces launch evidence independently

artifact_export.format: ordinary zip with lossless compression; numeric arrays npz lossless without changing float dtype; no quantization or truncation

layout.results: metrics, efficiency, full curves, config/plan/source/data hashes, threshold, selection reason, validation/test snippet/entity scores, ordered ID and label mapping; shared per-dataset mapping stored once with explicit package dependency
layout.weights: selected model/IF forest, RCR calibration or SVDD center, full inference configuration; separate from results for optional download
layout.native_scores: all required native validation/test point/window scores and mapping/offsets, separate compressed detailed evidence; no need to download for aggregate tables
layout.recovery: latest full optimizer/scheduler/RNG/sampler/early-stop state while running; interrupted cells retain separate recovery archive; completed cells can keep a separately downloadable recovery archive, never put it into small results package

artifact_export.granularity: per dataset/method/seed cell; shared metadata once per dataset; completed cell packaged promptly, not only at notebook termination
artifact_export.size_policy: target results zip<=256MiB, weights/detail zip<=512MiB per file; if too large shard records into independent npz members with global offsets and package manifest, never downsample or remove required results; targets not guaranteed compression ratios
artifact_export.verification: relative paths only, explicit allowlist; validate every archive CRC and manifest member count/size/SHA256; publish archive index with byte size, SHA256, task/kernel/scriptVersionId where available, dataset/model/seed and dependencies
artifact_export.retention: do not delete original datasets or historical artifacts; avoid keeping duplicate unpacked completed output in Kaggle export only AFTER verified archives; incomplete evidence must never be labelled complete
artifact_export.download: Kaggle Output full pagination and matching scriptVersionId; download results first, weights/native/recovery by need; all required evidence remains downloadable
artifact_export.implementation_status: implemented in src/experiments/artifacts.py; CRC/SHA256 and lossless archive regression tests passed locally; Kaggle launch still requires archive smoke

efficiency_metrics.file: efficiency.json per cell plus merged efficiency.csv
size: total and trainable parameter counts (selected SVDD encoder and AE separately)
IF tree count and nodes (no neural parameter count)
time: AE/SVDD or other training seconds per epoch and total
full validation seconds per epoch and total
validation and test scoring seconds separately
end-to-end wallclock and elapsed per resumed segment
memory: phase peak torch CUDA allocated bytes
phase peak torch CUDA reserved bytes
sampled process RSS peak with interval and measured scope
optional device-memory/utilization sample mean/max with interval; N/A if unavailable
throughput: training windows/sec with actual used windows and optimizer updates
mean time per snippet from complete scoring (not claimed single-request latency)
efficiency_metrics.measurement: synchronize CUDA at measured stage/epoch boundaries, monotonic wall timer; reset memory peaks per phase; do not synchronize every batch solely for metrics; phase outputs preserve exact timing scope and whether IO included; per-batch warmup excluded only in separately labelled microbenchmarks, included in end-to-end cost
efficiency_metrics.fairness: separate CPU IF and GPU training; no cross-GPU speed ranking; preserve actual hardware/batch; no claim FLOPs equivalent for attention/stochastic/tree methods; failed metrics N/A, not zero
efficiency_metrics.implementation_status: implemented phase timers, CUDA allocated/reserved peaks, RSS sampler and summary CSV; actual hardware values collected per cell
